title: Video Edit: Change the background describes only one of two kept characters
description: Found in MPI-1151 (2026-10-16). With Input_Who 'The monkey and the horse', the app's describer filled Input_Kept with the monkey only (flowVideoEdit_001/_002/_003 sidecars, project 'Deepinfra model tests'): the video-edit FlowDef's describe question for the clip's first frame asks for ONE person ('Describe only the main person'). Template 4 then says '{who} in <Video 1>, who stays exactly as filmed: {kept}', naming two subjects but describing one. It did not break the MPI-1151 bench (horse kept by eye), but a second kept subject is unanchored; the horse's head swinging over the monkey's face in _003 may be this. Fix: the describe question for template 4 should describe every subject named in {who} (or every person/animal/character in the frame). The question lives in js/data/flowsRegistry.js (video-edit describe); bench with logs/mpi1151/ inputs and MPI-1036/research/bench/run_flow.py M5 preset with a two-subject kept text, eye-test by Fabio.
